correctness.rationale: The all-B,d1,d2>0 spectral half-line follows from ordered fiber continuity between split and merged transverse Landau lists and a fresh check of the exact Landau-step count N_w(E+2B)-N_w(E)=floor(w sqrt(E+B)/pi). With E-B=t^2, the two-term lattice bound gives N_m(E)-N_d(E+2B)>=t^2/(4B)-At-Q; choosing merged levels spaced 2B produces adjacent covered intervals above explicit E_*. The finite union of continuous compact-resolvent fiber ranges below E_* proves finitely many bounded gaps. IMPORTANT harmless direction typo in RESULT.md: for H(p)=(p+Bx)^2 with screen x>=0, p->-infinity centers in the divided region and p->+infinity in merged region, the opposite of the printed p-sign labels. Reversing those two limits does not alter any interval argument, since both endpoints are used without orientation. This should be corrected before public synchronization, but the stated spectral claim is valid.
